title: Cited facts (T29 line item h, T29-P3-C85; built from lab/T29/experiment/fact_schema.json without the secrets rule). Facts only, never verdicts. Every fact cites a file, a line and an exact token copied from that line.

cite.token: an exact substring of that line, at least 3 characters, taken from the construct the value is about (for a guard, its call)

unknown: If you cannot tell a value, give "unknown". Unknown never counts in the project's favour.
absence: A value saying something is not there (guard none, owner_source none, rls_enabled disabled) needs no citation.

authz.candidate: every HTTP handler, controller method or server action that reads or returns one stored record by an id

handler.about: cite the line that declares the handler

guard.about: what limits who reaches the record; cite the line that does it

record_id_source.about: cite where the id is read

owner_value_source.about: for owner_filter or owner_compare: cite where the owner value comes from

write_fields.candidate: every handler that creates or updates a stored record from request input

handler.about: cite the line that declares the handler

data_shape.about: cite the line that builds the written data

parser.about: for spread_parsed: cite the schema declaration

owner_source.about: cite where the owner or user id written comes from

rls.candidate: every table created in a SQL file in the project, named schema.table

rls_enabled.about: cite the ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY line

per_user_columns.columns: list of column names, [] if none
per_user_columns.about: the columns that hold a user, owner, patient or author id; cite the column's line

record: One object per candidate: {"rule": "authz|write_fields|rls", "candidate": <handler location or schema.table>, <field>: {"value": ..., "file": ..., "line": ..., "token": ...}, ...}. A field with no citation gives value only.
